أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمداني

notes: The first teller is the compiler himself, written by the text (rule 13 exception); the tool also heads the chain with him, so a duplicate may appear.
«أبيه» bare after علي بن إبراهيم is a relation; «أبيه جعفر بن محمد» is one link named جعفر بن محمد.
«عن آبائه» names no one: read as a relation link; the Prophet at the end is not a link.
